title: Get a licence to trade or run a stall in a public place
what: Get the council's licence before selling goods or services from a stall, or otherwise trading, in a street, on council property or in another public place.

laws.title: City of Swan Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026

sources.title: City of Swan Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 8.11(1), as made, Gazette No. 101, 5 Aug 2026
sources.quote: Subject to subclause 8.11(2) a person shall not set up or conduct trading in a thoroughfare or public place unless—

sources.title: City of Swan Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 8.11(1), as made, Gazette No. 101, 5 Aug 2026
sources.quote: (a) the person has obtained approval from the local government and is the holder of a valid and current street trading licence or is an assistant specified in the licence;

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.
